verdict.rationale: Airbyte Cloud's dbt Cloud integration lets dbt transformations run immediately following syncs, event-triggered rather than on a blind timer (airbyte-docs-11/27/36). However, this is limited to Airbyte Cloud with dbt Cloud specifically (not core/OSS dbt or other orchestrators), and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of this triggering behavior. missing for 10: OSS/self-hosted trigger support, native dbt-core (non-Cloud) integration, independent verification that transformations reliably fire post-sync rather than needing external orchestration.
